theorem smooth_iff_continuous_and_comp_immersion
    {𝕜 : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
    {E E' : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E']
    {M N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [TopologicalSpace N]
    [ChartedSpace E M] [ChartedSpace E' N]
    (f : M → N) :
    Smooth (𝓘(𝕜, E)) (𝓘(𝕜, E')) f ↔ 
    Continuous f ∧ 
    ∀ {M' : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace E M']
      (e : M' → M),
      Smooth (𝓘(𝕜, E)) (𝓘(𝕜, E)) e →
      (∀ x, LinearMap.ker (mfderiv (𝓘(𝕜, E)) (𝓘(𝕜, E)) e x) = ⊥) →
      Smooth (𝓘(𝕜, E)) (𝓘(𝕜, E')) (f ∘ e) := sorry
